question: On Thursday 16 October 2025, Mustafa Cakici, the spokesperson for the Gaza flotilla, was expelled from the organisation after his violently anti-Semitic remarks and denial of the Armenian genocide were disclosed1. This man, who still heads the pro-Palestinian collective in Doubs, France, rose to the highest ranks of this organisation without a single person finding his remarks shocking.
He even spoke out on numerous occasions in support of La France Insoumise (LFI) MEPs Emma Fourreau and Rima Hassan in front of European activists from The Left.

However, Cakici’s comments had been revealed in the press as early as October 20242, and representatives of the Gaza flotilla association and Deputies from LFI and The Left had been warned about his comments since the summer, without Cakici facing the slightest consequences3.

answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (11.3.2026) The Commission stands against all forms of antisemitism and firmly condemns it1. Antisemitism is incompatible with the core values and principles on which the EU is founded. Antisemitism poses a direct challenge to democracy, the rule of law and social cohesion in Europe. It is not for the Commission to comment on Members of the European Parliament’s behaviour and actions.
